title: ElectroNeek Named in Zinnov Zones' Top 100 Automation Platforms List
summary: ElectroNeek is transforming the automation industry with its innovative RPA, Intelligent Automation, and Intelligent Document Processing solutions, earning a spot as one of the top 100 automation platforms according to Zinnov Zones.
body_markdown:
**Austin, TX, March 15, 2023 - ElectroNeek receives recognition as one of the top automation platforms providing ground-breaking RPA, Intelligent Automation, and Intelligent Document Processing according to Zinnov Zones.**


ElectroNeek is transforming the automation industry with its innovative RPA, Intelligent Automation, and Intelligent Document Processing solutions, earning a spot as one of the top 100 automation platforms according to Zinnov Zones.


## **Zinnov Zones for Intelligent Automation (IA) Platforms – H1 2023**


Every year, Zinnov Zones evaluates the leading players in the Intelligent Automation space, assessing their success in Use Case Discovery, Intelligent Document Processing, RPA Platforms, and analytics and insights.


Zinnov Zones for Intelligent Automation (IA) Platforms – H1 2023 analyzed 100+ automation platforms and specialist vendors to identify the top leaders and visionaries equipped to meet the growing demand for automation.


The study rates the players based on their capabilities across the automation lifecycle, including Intelligent Automation, Process Intelligence, Intelligent Document Processing, RPA, Low Code Application Development, and Intelligent Virtual Agent.


## **ElectroNeek: Powering Groundbreaking Automation Trends Shaping the Automation Landscape**


The ElectroNeek RPA platform empowers MSPs to build automated business processes for themselves and their customers.


MSPs leverage ElectroNeek’s powerful[hub](https://electroneek.com/platform/) architecture to build, sell, and support end-user automation, improve business processes, and generate recurring revenue streams.


ElectroNeek's newest automation product,[IntelliDocs](https://electroneek.com/platform/intellidocs/) , is the first-ever Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) solution specifically designed for MSPs and IT Service Providers.


IntelliDocs fuses the power of OCR and IDP to empower users to automatically recognize digital documents, understand their types and extract essential information, supported by MSP-centric monetization and management tools.


IntelliDocs automatically processes invoices and thousands of other model types, works across all major categories and languages, and formats pdfs and images.

## **ElectroNeek Raises the Bar for Intelligent Automation**


*“The Automation industry has experienced an unprecedented surge in adoption due to the COVID pandemic, leading to the growth and development of new and innovative solutions to meet the needs of the modern enterprise.*


*Automation has become an essential business necessity, playing a major role in improving efficiency, improved accuracy, and reduced costs.*


*Our goal at ElectroNeek is to continue as an integral contributor to shaping the future of automation.*


*Zinnov Zone's recognition is a great opportunity to demonstrate our excellence in the automation industry.”*


**Sergey Yudovskiy, Co-Founder and CEO at ElectroNeek**
